notes.subject: התוו
notes.rationale: Root תוה 'set a mark/bound': KJV/Geneva 'limited', ASV 'grieved/provoked' — rendered here literally as 'set a boundary on him'.

notes.subject: קדוש ישראל
notes.rationale: 'The Holy One of Israel' rendered as bound construct 'Yisrayila ka Senu-mɔgɔ', keeping the possessive chain.

notes.subject: ⟨a kan⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew has no preposition on התוו's object; Bambara needs 'on him' to complete 'set a limit'.

translation: U ye u yɛrɛ segin, u ye El sinjira, u ye Yisrayila ka Senu-mɔgɔ daɲɛ bila ⟨a kan⟩.
